import mailbox
import os
import smtplib
import subprocess
from email.mime.text import MIMEText
from time import sleep

from mailman.core.initialize import initialize
from mailman.interfaces.listmanager import IListManager
from zope.component import getUtility

DOMAIN = "local.edu"
CFG = "/etc/mailman3/mailman.cfg"


def send_email(*, body, subject, from_addr, to_addr):
    msg = MIMEText(body)
    msg["Subject"] = subject
    msg["From"] = from_addr
    msg["To"] = to_addr
    with smtplib.SMTP("localhost", 25) as server:
        server.send_message(msg)


def get_mlist():
    initialize(CFG)
    return getUtility(IListManager).get(f"reading-group@{DOMAIN}")


def find_confirm(user, want):
    mbox = mailbox.mbox(f"/var/mail/{user}")
    cands = [m for m in mbox
             if (m.get("From") or "").startswith("reading-group-confirm")
             and want in (m.get("Subject") or "")]
    return cands[-1] if cands else None


def has(user, needle):
    mbox = mailbox.mbox(f"/var/mail/{user}")
    return any(needle in (m.get("Subject") or "") for m in mbox)


def confirm(user, want):
    msg = find_confirm(user, want)
    assert msg, f"no {want} confirmation for {user}"
    send_email(body="", subject="", from_addr=f"{user}@{DOMAIN}",
               to_addr=msg.get("From"))


def new_user():
    u = os.urandom(8).hex()
    subprocess.run(["useradd", u], check=True, capture_output=True)
    return u


a = new_user()
b = new_user()
print("users:", a, b)

mlist = get_mlist()
assert mlist.subscription_policy.name == "confirm", mlist.subscription_policy
assert mlist.unsubscription_policy.name == "confirm", mlist.unsubscription_policy
print("policies OK: sub=%s unsub=%s" % (
    mlist.subscription_policy.name, mlist.unsubscription_policy.name))

# --- two users join and confirm ---
for u in (a, b):
    send_email(body="", subject="", from_addr=f"{u}@{DOMAIN}",
               to_addr=f"reading-group-join@{DOMAIN}")
for u in (a, b):
    ok = False
    for _ in range(10):
        sleep(2)
        try:
            confirm(u, "join")
            ok = True
            break
        except AssertionError:
            continue
    assert ok, f"{u} join confirmation never arrived"
for u in (a, b):
    ok = False
    for _ in range(10):
        sleep(2)
        if get_mlist().members.get_member(f"{u}@{DOMAIN}"):
            ok = True
            break
    assert ok, f"{u} did not become a member"
print("both users joined and confirmed")

# --- announcement reaches both subscribers ---
subject = "Announcement " + os.urandom(4).hex()
send_email(body="hello readers", subject=subject,
           from_addr=f"{a}@{DOMAIN}", to_addr=f"reading-group@{DOMAIN}")
for u in (a, b):
    ok = False
    for _ in range(15):
        sleep(2)
        if has(u, subject):
            ok = True
            break
    assert ok, f"announcement not delivered to {u}"
print("ANNOUNCEMENT DELIVERED to both subscribers")

# --- leave flow for user a ---
send_email(body="", subject="", from_addr=f"{a}@{DOMAIN}",
           to_addr=f"reading-group-leave@{DOMAIN}")
ok = False
for _ in range(10):
    sleep(2)
    if get_mlist().members.get_member(f"{a}@{DOMAIN}"):
        ok = True
        break
assert ok, "user was removed without confirming"
print("user a still a member before confirming leave (correct)")

got = False
for _ in range(10):
    sleep(2)
    try:
        confirm(a, "leave")
        got = True
        break
    except AssertionError:
        continue
assert got, "no leave confirmation email"

removed = False
for _ in range(15):
    sleep(2)
    if get_mlist().members.get_member(f"{a}@{DOMAIN}") is None:
        removed = True
        break
assert removed, "user a NOT removed after confirming leave"
print("LEAVE FLOW OK: user a removed after confirmation")

# --- b must still be subscribed, and a must no longer receive ---
assert get_mlist().members.get_member(f"{b}@{DOMAIN}"), "user b lost membership"
